topic.source_contract: population profile, health inequalities, determinants, assessment scope, evidence, engagement, mitigation, design commitments, delivery and health monitoring evidence

sources.publisher: Office for Health Improvement and Disparities
Office for Health Improvement and Disparities

scope_guards: A generic healthy-place checklist is not treated as a site-specific HIA.
A population average is not treated as the distributional impact on vulnerable groups.
Access shown by straight-line distance is not treated as safe usable access.
A mitigation recommendation is not treated as a secured planning obligation.
A design intention is not treated as constructed healthy infrastructure.
A travel plan target is not treated as achieved behaviour change.
A completed development is not treated as demonstrated health improvement.
No score or promotion is written without exact population, exposure, mitigation, delivery and monitored outcome evidence.
row_checks: Current policy trigger and proportionality required
Competent and independent assessment team required
Current resident and future-user profile required
Current health and wellbeing indicators required
Relevant neighbourhood and service catchments required
Quality, affordability and displacement effects required
Active travel, road danger and severance required
Day, night and cumulative exposure required
Healthy food access and unhealthy concentration required
Crime, fear and inclusive design required
Healthcare, schools and community facilities required
Job quality, access and construction effects required
Affected communities and public-health bodies required
Positive and negative effects by group required
Hierarchy, owner and delivery mechanism required
Indicators, thresholds and remedial actions required
Map, policy or strategy alone is not exact-site delivery
Application or proposal is not approval
Funding announcement is not completed delivery
Current operational use or service required
